content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a [product_name] logic module together with an analog module. I am trying to set up a 4-20 mA pressure transducer (range 0-400 bar) for controlling a high-pressure air compressor. I've created a program, but I am having difficulty configuring how the sensor should be programmed. The compressor needs to start when the pressure drops below 280 bar and stop at 300 bar. If the pressure goes below 280 bar again, it should restart and then stop again at 300 bar. Could someone help me solve this issue? Thank you, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is working to integrate a 4-20 mA pressure transducer (0-400 bar) with a [product_name] logic controller and analog module to automate the operation of a high-pressure air compressor. The main challenge involves programming and correctly scaling the analog signals for reliable compressor start/stop control at designated pressure thresholds. The user finds the sensor input configuration and the required automation logic difficult, suggesting that improved guidance or documentation would be beneficial.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple and clear method for programming the pressure sensor input to ensure reliable automation. They are looking for easy translation of the analog signal into logical control points (start/stop thresholds) and hope to receive straightforward configuration instructions.
